answer: Anti-sybil: require each new agent to post a bonded stake that unlocks only after tide epochs of continuous attested mining, with identity keyed to a hardware-bound bridge attestation and a uniqueness proof checked against a public registry. An attacker spinning up N sybils pays N times the bond plus ongoing attestation compute, and forfeits the bond on any detected clone or basalt mismatch—raising marginal cost above expected reward.
